IELTS Task 2 Assessment Criteria

🎯 Task Response

Address all parts of the prompt, take a clear position where required and maintain it throughout, support ideas with relevant, well-extended examples.

🔗 Coherence & Cohesion

Logical paragraphing (intro, body, body, conclusion), clear progression of ideas, effective referencing and linking used naturally rather than mechanically.

📚 Lexical Resource

Range of topic-specific and academic vocabulary, precise word choice, natural collocations, controlled use of less common items.

📑 Grammatical Range

Mix of complex sentence types (conditionals, relative clauses, passive voice), accurate punctuation, majority of sentences error-free.

📌 Good to know

Task 2 counts for roughly two-thirds of your overall Writing band score, double the weight of Task 1, so strong Task 2 performance matters even more for your final result.
